name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Switch between views on the same page, one panel at a time.

.tx-tabs-list-leather .tx-tabs-trigger[d.background-image:
linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent calc(100% - 15px), var(--tx-leather-edge) calc(100% - 13px), transparent calc(100% - 9px)),
      radial-gradient(rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2) 0.7px, transparent 1px)

.tx-tabs-list-leather .tx-tabs-trigger[d.background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--tx-rivet) 45%, var(--tx-leather)), var(--tx-leather-edge) 80%)
.tx-tabs-list-leather .tx-tabs-trigger[d.box-shadow:
inset 0 0 0 1px var(--tx-leather-edge),
      0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--tx-leather-foreground) 22%, transparent)
